Quell the [[Dredge]] revolt against the [[Kurzick]]s by killing the Dredge leader [[Maximole]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Kill Maximole and his followers to quell the revolt.
* See Moleneaux for your reward.

===Reward===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 750 [[Kurzick Faction]]
* 250 [[Gold]]
* [[Equipment Requisition]]

==Walkthrough==
Maximole and his group can be found [[patrol]]ling in Ferndale a little way west of [[Aspenwood Gate (Kurzick)]]; however, beware of the other patrolling groups of Dredge in the area that you should deal with first before moving to Maximole's group.  Maximole will typically be found with 3-4 other Dredge.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Moleneaux
:''"More trouble! And so I must ask you for your assistance yet again. My people have never been quick to anger, but given time, their thirst for justice can be fierce. Our recent plight has finally driven a small group of my clan to advocate war...all-out war...against the Kurzicks! Their leader is a bold, angry Dredge named Maximole. He lost his family during our long escape, and I believe he wants to simply die in battle. But he wishes to drag down all of our people with him. There is only one way out. If you will eliminate '''Maximole''', the others will see why we should avoid the Kurzicks rather than fight them. Will you help me? When it is over, the others will understand. I will see to it."''
{{offer dialog
|accept = Yes, it is the only way.
|decline = What, and give up my last chance to get you Dredge off my back?
|ask = If you don't hurry, '''Maximole''' will bring the wrath of the Kurzicks down on all of us! 
|indent = :: }}

===Reward dialogue===
;Moleneaux
:''"I know this was not easy, but it was necessary. I think we may have a future here after all. Thank you."''
